tier_reason: The SpGEMM_Benchmarks wiki links raw per-matrix tables (xlsx) against cuSPARSE (CUDA 8.0.44), MKL 18.0.128 and viennaCL 1.7.1; the benchmark driver is public (perf_test/sparse/KokkosSparse_spgemm.cpp at tag 2.6.00 exposes --algorithm CUSPARSE|MKL|MKL2|VIENNA), and the configure pages give compilers, full CXXFLAGS, run procedure and the GPU model (Tesla P100-SXM2-16GB). I re-derived every ratio in claimed_speedup from the xlsx tables and they match exactly.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: P100 runs: nvcc_wrapper with gcc 5.4.0 and CUDA 8.0.44, CXXFLAGS='-Wall -pedantic -Werror -O3 -g -Wshadow -Wsign-compare -Wignored-qualifiers -Wempty-body -Wclobbered -Wuninitialized', KOKKOS_ARCHS=Pascal60,Power8, KOKKOSKERNELS_TPLS=cusparse, eti-only, double/int; KNL runs: icpc from module intel/compilers/18.0.128 (the SpGEMM page names MKL intel-18.0.128) with the same CXXFLAGS, KOKKOS_ARCHS=KNL, MKL TPL; Power8 runs: g++ 5.4.0, same CXXFLAGS, KOKKOS_ARCHS=Power8. OMP_PROC_BIND=spread, OMP_PLACES=threads; 6 runs with the first discarded as warm-up.
corrections.caveats: Results are from 2018 (Kokkos 2.50, Kokkos Kernels 2.60, CUDA 8 cuSPARSE, MKL 18.0, P100 and KNL hardware); modern cuSPARSE/MKL SpGEMM may differ. On P100 KKSPGEMM is on average slower than Nsparse (v1.2): faster on only 28 of 77 multiplications, geomean 0.92x (derived from page data). None of the baselines is in the catalog's listed set (SuiteSparse, Eigen sparse, PETSc). Per-matrix times are best over thread counts (32-256), and MKL-INS times exclude Trilinos-style post-processing ('Actual DOUBLE MKL SPMM Time Without Free'), while MKL7/MKL8 exclude 1-based conversion. KNL CPU SKU is not given (only '68 cores', quadrant mode), Power8 SKU not given; the P100 GPU model is stated in the logged output. The current perf_test driver no longer offers the cuSPARSE/MKL/viennaCL algorithm options; reproducing needs the 2.6.00-era tag. The wiki is marked deprecated in favour of kokkos.org docs. The P100 xlsx sheet is named 'Power8' internally but holds the P100 columns (KKSPGEMM, KKMEM, KKLP, cuSPARSE, Nsparse, viennaCL). The wiki SpMV page compares only against Kokkos Kernels' own reference, so SpMV carries no incumbent comparison.

notes: All ratios (P100 cuSPARSE 3.61x on 75/81, viennaCL 1.95x on 62/72, Nsparse 0.92x on 28/77; KNL-DDR MKL-INS 1.25x, MKL7 1.79x, MKL8 2.95x; KNL-cache 1.19x/2.25x/3.75x; Power8 viennaCL 2.79x on 78/83) reproduced exactly from the four xlsx tables.
